nameOrigin: hump-backed mammal commonly found in desert areas
explode, eject molten lava from a volcano

pokedexEntries.ru: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

pokedexEntries.sa: The humps on CAMERUPT’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This POKéMON apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

pokedexEntries.frlg: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

pokedexEntries.em: A POKéMON that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

pokedexEntries.bw: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.

pokedexEntries.x: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.

pokedexEntries.y: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
